title: LIVORA
description:
BUILD A LIFE. LIVE WITH WHAT FOLLOWS.LIVORA is a detailed life simulation game where the choices you make shape the person you become, the people around you and the life you build.

Create your character and step into one continuous life. Work, study, manage money, find a home, build relationships, spend your free time, travel, raise a family, deal with setbacks and make the most of the opportunities that come your way.

There is no perfect route through LIVORA.

Every decision competes for your time, money and attention — and what feels like the right choice today might create consequences much later.

CREATE YOUR LIFEStart by creating your character and deciding the circumstances your Life begins with.

From there, it is yours to shape.

You might build a successful career, retrain for something completely different, struggle with money, buy a home, fall in love, start a family, travel, make friends, develop hobbies or simply try to keep everything together.

Your priorities can change as your circumstances change.

The Life you start with does not have to be the Life you end up living.

YOUR CHOICES HAVE CONSEQUENCESLIVORA is built around thousands of playable situations, conversations, decisions and moments covering the ordinary, exciting, difficult and unexpected parts of life.

Some decisions are immediate.

Others stay with you.

How you treat somebody can affect the relationship you have with them later. Spending heavily might make sense now but leave you exposed when an unexpected bill arrives. Ignoring a problem may make it disappear for a while — but not necessarily forever.

People remember things. Unfinished problems can return. Relationships change. Opportunities appear and disappear.

Small choices can become part of much bigger stories.

BUILD A CAREER — AND ACTUALLY GO TO WORKYour career is more than a job title and a monthly salary.

Search for opportunities, apply for jobs, attend interviews and build a working life that fits the person you want to become.

When you are working, your job becomes a playable part of your Life.

Handle situations during the working day, make decisions, deal with colleagues, manage pressure and decide how much of yourself you are prepared to give to your career.

Your working life can change too.

You may be employed, unemployed, self-employed, building a business or looking for an entirely new direction.

Success at work can open doors — but it may cost you time, energy and attention elsewhere.

STUDY FOR SOMETHING BETTEREducation can become part of your everyday Life.

Choose what to study and balance your course against work, money, relationships and everything else demanding your attention.

Manage study hours, modules, assignments, deadlines and exams. Prepare for assessments, deal with study pressure and make decisions when your education clashes with the rest of your Life.

A qualification might create better opportunities later.

Getting there is the challenge.

FIND SOMEWHERE TO CALL HOMEWhere you live can change throughout your Life.

Rent somewhere of your own, search the property market or work towards buying a home.

Browse properties, attend viewings, submit rental applications, manage deposits, make offers, arrange mortgages and work through the process of actually moving.

If you become a homeowner, manage your mortgage and equity, improve your surroundings and eventually decide whether it is time to sell and move on.

Your home is more than a number on a screen.

Your household, belongings, pets, rooms and the people you live with can all become part of the Life happening inside it.

MANAGE THE REALITY OF MONEYThe Life you want still has to be paid for.

Earn money, pay bills, manage everyday spending, use credit when necessary and decide what is worth sacrificing for.

Your financial position affects what becomes possible.

Save for a home. Spend on experiences. Take on debt. Invest. Build financial security. Deal with unexpected costs. Decide whether you can really afford that holiday, night out, purchase or change of direction.

Having more money can make Life easier.

It does not automatically make it better.

BUILD RELATIONSHIPS THAT CAN CHANGE YOUR LIFEFriends, partners, family, colleagues and the people you meet along the way can all become part of your story.

Go on dates. Spend time together. Communicate. Make memories. Handle disagreements. Repair damaged relationships or allow people to drift away.

A relationship can grow from dating into sharing a home, commitment, engagement, wedding planning and marriage.

Families can grow. Responsibilities can change.

And not every relationship lasts forever.

The decisions you make with other people can affect your home, finances, social life, family and future.

LIVE OUTSIDE THE ROUTINELife is not just work and bills.

Choose how you spend your evenings, weekends and free days.

Explore Life Places, decide where you want to go and fill your time with activities that suit the Life you are living.

Eat out. Exercise. Shop. Meet friends. Go on dates. Attend events. Pursue hobbies. Spend time with family. Stay home. Try something different.

Sometimes you can plan an entire day from morning to night.

Plans can change, opportunities can appear and one part of the day can influence what happens later.

HAVE A SOCIAL LIFEYour relationships continue beyond individual conversations.

Receive invitations, organise plans, join recurring groups and take part in playable Group Chats where friends, family and other people can talk, disagree, make plans and expect a response from you.

Go to parties, weddings, gigs, festivals, dinners, sporting events, nights out, reunions and other social occasions.

You can be the person who always turns up.

The person who says no because money is tight.

The one who organises everything.

Or the one who slowly stops replying.

People notice.

GO SOMEWHERETake short breaks and holidays when everyday Life needs a change of scenery.

Choose where to go, how to travel, where to stay and what you want to do while you are there.

Travel alone, with a partner, friends or family.

Spend your days sightseeing, relaxing, eating, exploring, going out or changing your plans when something unexpected happens.

A holiday can become one of the best memories of your Life.

It can also be expensive, chaotic and very different from the trip you imagined.

MAKE ROOM FOR THE SMALL THINGSNot every important moment needs to change your entire future.

Build hobbies. Adopt a pet. Reconnect with somebody. Celebrate birthdays. Enjoy quiet days. Have a brilliant weekend. Deal with an awkward message. Go somewhere simply because you feel like it.

LIVORA mixes major milestones with the smaller moments that make a Life feel personal.

Sometimes nothing dramatic happens.

And sometimes those ordinary days become the ones worth remembering.

EVERYTHING IS CONNECTEDLIVORA is built as one connected life simulation.

Your job affects your money and free time.

Your money affects your home and social life.

Your home affects your relationships and responsibilities.

Your relationships affect your decisions.

Your education can change your career.

Your health and energy affect what you can realistically take on.

Your choices create memories, consequences and unfinished business that can influence what happens next.

You are rarely managing one system at a time.

You are managing a Life.

LIVE THROUGH THE YEARSYour story is not limited to a few weeks.

Time moves forward. Circumstances change. Careers develop. Relationships evolve. Families grow. Priorities shift.

The things that matter when you are starting out may look completely different later in Life.

You can build financial security, experience major relationships, become a parent, change careers, develop interests, face difficult periods, enjoy successful ones and eventually look back at the Life your decisions created.

There is no requirement to maximise everything.

There is no single definition of success.

Build the Life that matters to you — and live with what follows.
description_short: Create your character and build a life shaped by every choice. Work, study, manage money, find a home, build relationships, explore, travel and face thousands of moments where decisions, opportunities and consequences shape what happens next.
